ex.en: His argument seems illogical to me.
ex.zh: 我覺得他的論點不合邏輯。

ex.en: It's illogical to raise prices when sales are falling.
ex.zh: 銷售下滑時還漲價，這不合邏輯。

illogical.en: not sensible because it does not follow clear reasons

ex.en: He has been ill in bed for four days.
ex.zh: 他已經臥病在床四天了。

ex.en: Being ill, I stayed at home all day long.
ex.zh: 我生病了，整天待在家裡。

ex.en: Tom said he was ill, which was a lie.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他生病了，但那是謊話。

ex.en: You are too ready to speak ill of others.
ex.zh: 你太喜歡說別人壞話了。

ex.en: I have never heard him speak ill of others.
ex.zh: 我從來沒聽過他說別人壞話。

ill.en: to say bad things about someone

ex.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
ex.zh: 工作流程如下圖所示。

ex.en: Let me illustrate my point with an example.
ex.zh: 讓我舉個例子來說明我的論點。

ex.en: The chart illustrates our sales growth over the past year.
ex.zh: 這張圖表說明了我們過去一年的業績成長。

illustrate.en: to make something clear by giving examples or pictures

ex.en: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.
ex.zh: 幫這本書畫插圖的畫家非常厲害。

ex.en: The children's book is beautifully illustrated.
ex.zh: 這本童書的插圖畫得很漂亮。

illustrate.en: to add pictures to a book or story

ex.en: He could not come because of his serious illness.
ex.zh: 他因為病重而不能來。

ex.en: He was absent from school on account of illness.
ex.zh: 他因病沒去上學。

ex.en: Serious illnesses call for emergency care.
ex.zh: 重病需要緊急治療。

illness.en: the state of being sick, or a particular disease

ex.en: This book has a lot of illustrations.
ex.zh: 這本書有很多插圖。

ex.en: The illustrations in this book are beautiful.
ex.zh: 這本書裡的插圖很漂亮。

illustration.en: a picture in a book or article that helps explain the text

ex.en: To give a definition of a word is more difficult than to give an illustration of its usage.
ex.zh: 為一個字下定義，比舉例說明它的用法還難。

ex.en: As an illustration, let's look at last year's sales.
ex.zh: 舉例來說，我們來看看去年的銷售。

illustration.en: an example or story that makes a point easier to understand

ex.en: A mirror wall in the room creates an illusion of spaciousness.
ex.zh: 房間裡的鏡面牆營造出寬敞的錯覺。

ex.en: Everything you saw was an illusion.
ex.zh: 你看到的一切都是幻覺。

ex.en: It's just an optical illusion.
ex.zh: 那只是視覺錯覺。

illusion.en: something that looks real or true but is not

ex.en: He had the illusion that he was a genius.
ex.zh: 他誤以為自己是天才。

ex.en: I have no illusions about how hard this job will be.
ex.zh: 我很清楚這份工作會有多辛苦。

illusion.en: a false idea or belief that someone has about something

ex.en: The room was illuminated with red lights.
ex.zh: 這個房間被紅色的燈照亮了。

ex.en: The square was illuminated by bright lights.
ex.zh: 廣場被鮮明的燈火照亮。

ex.en: The street is illuminated by many lights.
ex.zh: 許多燈照亮了街道。

illuminate.en: to fill a place with light or decorate it with lights

ex.en: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.
ex.zh: 陽光照亮田野，痛苦點亮心靈。

ex.en: The professor's lecture illuminated the causes of the war.
ex.zh: 教授的課闡明了戰爭的成因。

illuminate.en: to make something easier to understand by explaining it clearly

ex.en: It's illegal to park your car here.
ex.zh: 把車停在這裡是違法的。

ex.en: Bicycles traveling to the right of automobiles is illegal.
ex.zh: 腳踏車騎在汽車右側是違法的。

ex.en: I've never done anything illegal in my life.
ex.zh: 我這輩子從來沒做過違法的事。

ex.en: The car was illegally parked in front of the shop.
ex.zh: 那輛車違規停在店門口。

ex.en: They were arrested for illegally selling tickets.
ex.zh: 他們因非法販賣門票而被逮捕。

ex.en: The police closed down an illicit gambling den.
ex.zh: 警方查封了一間非法賭場。

ex.en: The two had an illicit meeting that nobody was supposed to know about.
ex.zh: 兩人進行了一場不能讓人知道的不正當會面。

ex.en: The court ruled that the contract was illegitimate.
ex.zh: 法院裁定這份合約不合法。

ex.en: Many citizens saw the new government as illegitimate.
ex.zh: 許多市民認為新政府不具正當性。

ex.en: It is illegitimate to use customer data without permission.
ex.zh: 未經許可使用客戶資料是不正當的。

ex.en: The room's only illumination came from a single candle.
ex.zh: 房間唯一的光源是一根蠟燭。

ex.en: Good illumination is important for reading at night.
ex.zh: 充足的照明對夜間閱讀很重要。

ex.en: The teacher's example offered real illumination on the topic.
ex.zh: 老師舉的例子對這個主題帶來了真正的啟發。

ex.en: The book provides illumination for readers who find history confusing.
ex.zh: 這本書為覺得歷史難懂的讀者提供了清楚的說明。

ex.en: I bought an illustrated book for my niece.
ex.zh: 我買了一本有插圖的書給姪女。

ex.en: The illustrated guide made the recipe easy to follow.
ex.zh: 附圖解的指南讓食譜很容易照著做。

illustrated.zh: 說明；舉例（illustrate 的過去式）

ex.en: The teacher illustrated the idea with a simple drawing.
ex.zh: 老師用一張簡單的圖說明這個概念。

ex.en: Her story illustrated how kindness can change a life.
ex.zh: 她的故事說明了善意如何改變一個人的生命。

ex.en: The illustrator drew colorful pictures for the children's book.
ex.zh: 這位插畫家為童書畫了色彩繽紛的插圖。

ex.en: My sister dreams of becoming a professional illustrator.
ex.zh: 我妹妹夢想成為專業插畫家。

ex.en: Many people in the village were illiterate a hundred years ago.
ex.zh: 一百年前，村裡有很多人不識字。

ex.en: The charity teaches illiterate adults how to read.
ex.zh: 這個慈善機構教不識字的成人讀書寫字。

ex.en: He felt ashamed of being illiterate and hid it from others.
ex.zh: 他因為不識字而感到羞愧，並向別人隱瞞。

ex.en: The program helped thousands of illiterates learn to read.
ex.zh: 這個計畫幫助了數千名文盲學會閱讀。

ex.en: In the past, most farmers were illiterates.
ex.zh: 過去大多數農民都是文盲。

ex.en: She comes from an illustrious family of scientists.
ex.zh: 她來自一個赫赫有名的科學家家族。

ex.en: The university has an illustrious history.
ex.zh: 這所大學有著輝煌的歷史。

ex.en: The sense of safety was illusory.
ex.zh: 那種安全感只是幻覺。

ex.en: Their progress proved illusory when the numbers came in.
ex.zh: 數據出來後，他們的進展被證明是虛幻的。

ex.en: The illuminated sign was visible from far away.
ex.zh: 那個發光的招牌從很遠的地方就看得到。

ex.en: The old bridge looks beautiful when it is illuminated at night.
ex.zh: 這座老橋在夜晚被燈光照亮時很美。

ex.en: A single candle illuminated the small room.
ex.zh: 一根蠟燭照亮了這個小房間。

ex.en: The fireworks illuminated the whole sky above the river.
ex.zh: 煙火照亮了河面上方的整片天空。

ex.en: Here is an illustrative example of how the rule works.
ex.zh: 這裡有個說明這條規則如何運作的例子。

ex.en: The book includes illustrative pictures on every page.
ex.zh: 這本書每一頁都有說明用的圖片。

ex.en: Illinois is a state in the Midwest of the United States.
ex.zh: 伊利諾州是美國中西部的一個州。

ex.en: Chicago is the largest city in Illinois.
ex.zh: 芝加哥是伊利諾州最大的城市。

illuminating.zh: 有啟發性的；令人茅塞頓開的

ex.en: The professor gave an illuminating talk on climate change.
ex.zh: 教授做了一場很有啟發性的氣候變遷演講。

ex.en: I found her comments on the book very illuminating.
ex.zh: 我覺得她對這本書的評論很有啟發。

ex.en: The government started a program to reduce illiteracy among adults.
ex.zh: 政府推出了一項降低成人文盲率的計畫。

ex.en: Illiteracy makes it hard to find a good job.
ex.zh: 不識字讓人很難找到好工作。

ex.en: I don't enjoy loud parties and other events of that ilk.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡吵鬧的派對和其他同類的活動。

ex.en: He and others of his ilk are always looking for easy money.
ex.zh: 他和那些同類型的人總是在找輕鬆賺錢的方法。

ex.en: People questioned the illegitimacy of the new government.
ex.zh: 人們質疑新政府的不合法性。

ex.en: The court ruled on the illegitimacy of the contract.
ex.zh: 法院就這份合約的不合法性做出了裁決。

ex.en: The court ruled on the illegality of the contract.
ex.zh: 法院就這份合約的違法性做出裁決。

ex.en: Nobody questioned the illegality of selling fake tickets.
ex.zh: 沒有人質疑販賣假票是違法的。

ex.en: His handwriting is so messy that it is almost illegible.
ex.zh: 他的字跡潦草到幾乎無法辨認。

ex.en: The old sign was faded and illegible.
ex.zh: 那塊舊招牌褪色了，字跡難以辨認。
